Re-based 2026-10-01 on rel085/fix-book, and BOOK_KAT_VERSION bumped to 2, because the book's behaviour changed on purpose. The model's flow used to walk past the last level of the maker's ladder into an agent's resting order at any price, so a slice that emptied the ladder filled the order at its own limit and printed it. This run did that: maker1's bid on BOOK6 at 67.96 filled 466 shares on day 0, tick 273, when the last print was 68.53, and the next tick's reference was 67.96, the agent's own price on the tape. The flow now stops at the ladder's last price, so that bid waits until the market comes down to it (tick 292, last print 67.99). The run is the same up to that fill; after it the fills, orders, impacts and prices differ because the tape no longer carries those prints (1,812 fills before, 1,790 after).
